task:
[Автозадача из бэклога] [operator] OKO VLM Глава 1/5 — GeminiVlmProvider (реальный провайдер, БЕЗ проводки в пайплайн). НЕ переписывать VlmGate/событийную архитектуру. Атомы:
1) src/oko/providers/gemini_vlm.py: class GeminiVlmProvider(VlmProvider), name=gemini, model по умолчанию gemini-2.5-flash; __init__(model, api_key_env=GEMINI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds=10.0, transport=None) — transport инъектируется как в http_vlm.py для офлайн-тестов; без сети при импорте.
2) query(request): POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/<model>:generateContent, заголовок x-goog-api-key; payload contents[].parts=[{text:prompt}] + {inline_data:{mime_type,data}} из request.image_b64 или image_path; парсить candidates[0].content.parts[].text; вернуть VlmResponse(text,provider=gemini,model,latency_ms). Ключ: сначала os.environ[api_key_env]; если пусто — fallback на ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json поле geminiApiKey (паттерн slopvid google_auth). Нет ключа нигде → RuntimeError с именем переменной (честно, НЕ пустой текст).
3) Хелперы: _gemini_inline_image(request) — base64 image_path если image_b64 нет; _extract_gemini_text(raw) — RuntimeError(Gemini response did not contain text) на пустом, НЕ возвращать пустую строку.
4) tests/test_gemini_vlm_provider.py (офлайн, инъект-transport): endpoint/model/x-goog-api-key/timeout переданы; image_b64 И image_path дают inline_data; нет ключа → RuntimeError с именем; пустой/мусорный JSON → RuntimeError (не фейк-текст). Детерминизм, без сети.
Шаблон gemini-вызова: bridge-projects/literary-slop-video/slopvid/providers.py (GeminiImageProvider) + google_auth.py. МОДЕЛЬ строго gemini-2.5-flash (НЕ pro, НЕ 3-flash). Проверка: pytest зелёный. Глава 1 из 5 (дальше factory, триггер, проводка, демо) — НЕ забегай вперёд.
goal: Implement a new `GeminiVlmProvider` class that integrates with the Google Gemini API (specifically `gemini-2.5-flash` model) to handle text and image inputs, parse responses, and manage API keys, all while adhering to existing architectural patterns and being fully testable offline.
constraints: Do NOT integrate the provider into the main pipeline yet.
The default model MUST be `gemini-2.5-flash` (NOT pro, NOT 3-flash).
Do NOT implement future chapters (factory, trigger, pipeline integration, demo).
The `_extract_gemini_text` helper MUST NOT return an empty string; it must raise a `RuntimeError` if text is missing.
The `RuntimeError` for a missing API key MUST include the variable name, not an empty text.
The `GeminiVlmProvider` MUST NOT require network access upon import.
Tests MUST be deterministic and run without network access (offline).
The `transport` mechanism MUST be injectable for offline testing.
known_context: An existing `VlmProvider` base class is available.
An existing `VlmResponse` data structure is available.
The `http_vlm.py` module provides a pattern for `transport` injection.
The `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable is the primary source for the API key.
A fallback API key source is `~/.bridge-private/secrets.json` with the field `geminiApiKey` (following the `slopvid google_auth` pattern).
Reference implementation for Gemini API calls and authentication can be found in `bridge-projects/literary-slop-video/slopvid/providers.py` (`GeminiImageProvider`) and `google_auth.py`.
The Gemini API requires an `x-goog-api-key` header.
The Gemini API payload structure for content is `contents[].parts=[{text:prompt}]` and `inline_data:{mime_type,data}` for images.
The Gemini API response text is located at `candidates[0].content.parts[].text`.
output_format: A Python module `src/oko/providers/gemini_vlm.py` containing the `GeminiVlmProvider` class and its helper methods, along with a corresponding test file `tests/test_gemini_vlm_provider.py`.
success_tests: The `GeminiVlmProvider` class is located at `src/oko/providers/gemini_vlm.py` and inherits from `VlmProvider`.
The `query` method sends a POST request to `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/<model>:generateContent`.
The `query` method includes the `x-goog-api-key` header in its requests.
The `query` method correctly formats text prompts into `contents[].parts=[{text:prompt}]`.
The `query` method correctly formats image data from `request.image_b64` or `request.image_path` into `inline_data:{mime_type,data}`.
The `query` method correctly parses the response text from `candidates[0].content.parts[].text`.
The `query` method returns a `VlmResponse` object with `text`, `provider='gemini'`, `model`, and `latency_ms`.
The API key lookup prioritizes `os.environ[api_key_env]` and falls back to `~/.bridge-private/secrets.json` (`geminiApiKey`).
A `RuntimeError` is raised with the correct variable name if no API key is found.
The `_gemini_inline_image` helper correctly converts `image_path` to base64 if `image_b64` is not provided.
The `_extract_gemini_text` helper raises `RuntimeError("Gemini response did not contain text")` if the extracted text is empty or missing, instead of returning an empty string.
Tests in `tests/test_gemini_vlm_provider.py` verify that `endpoint`, `model`, `x-goog-api-key`, and `timeout` are correctly passed.
Tests verify that both `image_b64` and `image_path` inputs result in correct `inline_data` in the request payload.
Tests verify that a `RuntimeError` with the variable name is raised if no API key is found.
Tests verify that a `RuntimeError` is raised for empty or malformed JSON responses, not returning fake text.
All tests are deterministic and run successfully without any network access.
